oneliner.t: Long-haul truck driver and small trucking-company owner who calls herself a 'conservative Democrat'; she won the July 21, 2026 Democratic primary over Raymond Keeler 65.7%–34.3% and faces Rep. Abe Hamadeh on Nov. 3.

born.t: Illinois (Galesburg per Ballotpedia); date not documented

hometown.t: Alliance, Nebraska (raised); family moved to Benson, Arizona in 1991

education_note.t: Attended the University of Arizona; no degree is listed.

upbringing.t: Born in Illinois and raised mainly in Alliance, Nebraska, where her father worked for BNSF for 24 years and her mother, who came to the U.S. at age ten, was a nursing director. The family moved to Benson, Arizona, in 1991 and she graduated from high school there in 1992. She attended the University of Arizona on an Army ROTC scholarship; a car accident changed her career path, and no military service is documented. She got her commercial driver's license in 1997 and has driven long-haul for more than 26 years. She adopted a daughter from China in 2007. Most of these details come from her own campaign biography as reported by her hometown paper.

education.school: High school in Benson, AZ (school not named)

career.role: Long-haul truck driver; owner-operator of a small trucking company

platform.t: Centers her campaign on protecting Social Security, Medicare and VA funding; pledges to expand Medicare and Medicaid.
Wants a Transportation and Infrastructure Committee seat to overhaul trucking regulations she says raise prices and enable drug flow across the border.
Secure the border while recognizing the need for legal workers, 'without sacrificing our humanity'; comprehensive immigration reform.
Two six-year Senate terms, six two-year House terms, ten-year terms for federal judges; quarterly town halls for every member.
Pro-choice, pro-union, pro-Ukraine, lifelong gun owner; supports reproductive, voting, Second Amendment and LGBTQIA+ rights.
Opposes tax breaks for billionaires; wants debt reduction without cutting essential services.

promises.t: Hold quarterly town halls (proposes the practice for every representative).
Seek a Transportation and Infrastructure seat to overhaul trucking rules.

claims.claim: 27 years as a solo long-haul truck driver, 3.5 million miles.

record.t: Her 2023 account (CDL obtained 1997; 26+ years) is consistent, but no license or business record was opened.
